summary: Frontend-only visual layer testing for 胜利28 dashboard (GameToolbar, CountdownRing, Pagination, Footer). All 8 requested features verified via Playwright on desktop 1920px. 100% pass rate; no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Pagination component: page-1 is only rendered as a shortcut when pages[0] > 1 (i.e. current page >= 7). At page=1 the '1' cell is rendered as part of the windowed pages loop with testid page-1; behavior is correct but worth noting for future authors.
CountdownRing: onZero is included in the useEffect dep array while `remaining` is not — safe here because setInterval uses functional updater. No action needed.
GameToolbar: skin state and muted state are component-local; if persistence is desired later, lift state up or persist to localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All feature tests in review_request verified working: game-toolbar with 7 tool buttons, help-dialog (contains 开奖规则/大小单双/玩法示例), records-dialog (7 bet-record rows with correct headers), placeholder toasts for tool-trend/profit/mode/auto/home, skin switching (retro/classic/modern with amber-500 active class), sound toggle (关声音 <-> 开声音), CountdownRing decrementing (0分59秒 -> 0分57秒 after 2.5s, format 'X分YY秒' ok), Pagination showing '共 3,042 记录 · 共 153 页', page-prev disabled at page 1, page-2/next/prev navigation switching red-600 active state, site-footer with 版权 and ICP text. No console errors observed.
